## Checklist

- [ ] Synthetic data only. No real customer, employer, buyer, pricing, or health data.
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, `.env` files, certificates, or Terraform state.
- [ ] No human confirmation gate or outreach boundary is weakened (or it was design-reviewed in an issue first).
- [ ] No scores, probabilities, or confidence percentages for BAECs or signal matches.
- [ ] No claim of scientific validation, purchase prediction, sales lift, or production security.
